svg.title: Component · PicPlace status · upload-paused · phone
svg.desc: Mirrors PicPlaceStatusCard (App/PicPlace/PicPlaceViews.swift) over the upload jobs of App/PicPlace/PicPlaceUploadJobs.swift (2026-09-24, code first, signed off from the Mac screenshots the same day): a person's Upload of a project's originals is a JOB that can pause and wait. While its run is going the header is the syncing state with **Pause** where every other sync says Cancel (actionButton), and the Originals/Blends lines hide. While it waits, ONE line replaces them (heavyLines → uploadJobLine): Upload paused (Cancel · Resume), Waiting for Wi-Fi (Cancel · Use mobile data — for this upload only, never the setting), Upload interrupted (Cancel · Resume; it also goes again on its own), Upload stopped (the reason first; Cancel · Try again), and Upload waiting (nothing held; the session or the launch holds it — not drawn: the paused line with its words). The two buttons sit beside the text when the detail fits on one line (jobLineRow's ViewThatFits — the Mac, the paused line on a phone) and on a line of their own, trailing, under it when not (a phone's waiting, interrupted and stopped lines — found drawing these: beside a wrapped detail, Use mobile data broke over two lines). Cancel is secondary grey, the first button accent, both 12.8pt semibold (heavyAction size 16 × 0.8), 14.4pt apart. The header keeps the project's own state — synced here, with auto-sync on so no Sync again — and its caption wraps to two lines at phone width, as the app's does. Demo data: the numbers of the 2026-09-24 screenshots (LL_PICPLACE=synced|syncing over jobs staged in the library's PicPlace/sync-state.json, iPhone 16 Pro simulator, iOS 27). The glyph column speaks the holdings pill's language (plan §16, signed off 2026-09-26 — glyph(for:size:) → statusGlyph(for:) → StatusGlyphView at 0.8 × the column, light palette, each symbol knocked out of its cloud in white): synced and changes wear the pill's rest cloud, the neutral ✓ checkmark.icloud.fill (#48484A) — never green, which now means only 'on this device'; not-synced the neutral ↑ icloud.and.arrow.up.fill; syncing and an upload job's run the amber ↑ (LL.accent #C36A00 on a light card); an upload PicPlace is still reading back the amber ↻ arrow.clockwise.icloud.fill (checking); failed, a conflict and a stopped upload job the red ! exclamationmark.icloud.fill (#D70015 — red, not the old system orange beside the amber); a paused, Wi-Fi-held or interrupted upload job the paused cloud (icloud.fill with pause bars knocked out); a preview the grey camera.fill (#AEAEB2 — its originals on PicPlace, not here); signed-out and not-connected icloud.slash in secondary. 2026-09-26, this file: the glyph was the green checkmark.icloud.fill; it is now the paused cloud — the synced header wears the pill's cloud, .waiting while the job is paused. Nothing else in the card changed.

g.data-symbol: icloud.fill + pause.fill knocked out (no paused cloud in SF Symbols)
